description:
Render a standard A4 report of the most auspicious dates for a chosen activity over a search window. Same window-scan engine as /vedic/muhurat/*: it scores each day by sunrise Panchang (Tithi/Vara/Nakshatra/Yoga/Karana) per Muhurta Chintamani + B.V.Raman, and lists ranked days with per-day Abhijit Muhurat and the scoring factors as the rationale. `activity` is one of the 12 from /muhurta/types. PDF default; ?format=html returns HTML.

[Group: Reports]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/reports/muhurta]
[Required: activity, search_window_start, latitude, longitude]
[Cost: 5,000 credits (Tier 7)] ⚠️ Premium — ~50% of free monthly budget. Confirm with user before invoking.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal school by name. Lahiri when omitted. Equivalent to ayanamsaId; send either.

format.description: `pdf` (default) stores a PDF and answers with its `url`. `html` returns one self-contained `text/html` document, `markdown` returns `text/markdown` with the same sections and tables; neither is stored. Same price in every format.

timezoneOffset.description: Hours from UTC at the given moment, not minutes. Fractional zones are hours too: 5.5 for India, 5.75 for Nepal, -3.5 for Newfoundland. Defaults to 0, meaning UTC.

headingColor.description: Colour of the divider rule under each section heading (not the heading text, which is themeColor).

themeColor.description: Accent colour, used for section heading text and inline emphasis.

name: astroway_reports_muhurta
title: Generate Muhurta Report (PDF or HTML)
